prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game-character source sheet for review only
Primary request: Create one transparent-background eight-pose character sheet of a fictional adult female radiologist, strongly preserving Image 2's Helly R from Severance-inspired identity: fair skin, auburn shoulder-length wavy hair with side part, alert reserved face, cream blouse, moss-green cardigan with long sleeves to wrists, charcoal trousers, and black shoes. Use Image 1 only for accepted rounded soft pixel-art proportions, black outlines, gentle pixel shading, eight-pose layout, and invisible-chair seated construction.
Input images: Image 1 is rounded-character style and layout only. Image 2 is Helly identity, face, hair, and clothing only.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent RGBA; no floor, furniture, glow, shadow, text, badge, label, logo, or watermark.
Composition/framing: exactly two rows by four poses. Top row S/front, E/right profile, W/left profile, N/back. Bottom row seated S/front, seated E/right profile, seated W/left profile, seated N/back. Full bodies and feet visible with even margins and consistent head/body scale.
Seated poses: invisible chair; knees about 90 degrees; thighs horizontal; feet visible; hands on thighs; no chair or other object. Profiles are true side views and north is a true back.
Constraints: exactly one consistent character; rounded compact sturdy proportions and soft pixel-art, not tall narrow anime or realistic; preserve hair, face, cardigan, blouse, trousers and shoes in all eight; cardigan sleeves are long in every pose; no cut-off limbs, duplicate fronts, equipment, or extra objects.
